narr: A very moist airmass and a nearly stationary front resulted in rounds of thunderstorms that produced flash flooding on June 6th. This included reports of flooding in Noble county, Ohio.
ev: State official reported that state Route 821 closed due to flash flooding in several locations.
Emergency manager reported that Route 285 was flooded in one lane and temporarily closed.
lsr: State Route 821 closed due to flash flooding.
911 center reported that County Road 821 is closed due to flooding. Time estimated based on radar.
Route 285 flooded (one lane). Temporarily closed. Time based on phone call with Noble County EMA.
